defaultConfigId.currentState: Accepted only by the analyzer create form and not persisted on Analyzer.
defaultConfigId.migration: Read only while selecting an explicit portable profile revision; replace with the pinned profile reference in OE-M1.

copiedPluginJson.currentState: analyzer_plugin_config.config can contain a copied bootstrap profile and analyzer instance settings without a profile reference.
copiedPluginJson.migration: Extract portable type behavior for preflight comparison, retain only analyzer instance overrides after cutover, and never treat the copy as profile authority.

analyzerTestMap.currentState: Each analyzer source code is an independent row bound to a local Test.
analyzerTestMap.migration: Preserve every source row and its local binding. Group analyzers only when their complete effective portable behavior is identical; never collapse aliases or infer a binding from another row.

qualitativeValues.currentState: openelis_code can contain free text or a display code instead of a durable Result Option identity.
qualitativeValues.migration: Resolve each value to one active Result Option owned by its mapped Test or report an explicit blocking anomaly.

existingAnalyzers.currentState: Analyzer rows identify installed connections but do not pin an immutable portable profile revision.
existingAnalyzers.migration: Preserve analyzer identity and require explicit profile selection. Never assign a profile by heuristic similarity or silently move an analyzer to a later revision.

analyzerQcRule.currentState: AnalyzerQcRule stores analyzer-specific control-result recognition behavior that is superseded by the pinned Bridge profile revision.

inventory.reason: The complete active rule set is canonically identical to the explicitly selected profile revision.
prerequisites: Pin and synchronize the selected profile revision
Retain the migration export and audit outcome

inventory.reason: The rule is schema-valid but differs from the explicitly selected profile revision.
prerequisites: Publish a new site profile identity and immutable revision through Bridge lifecycle
Pin and synchronize the analyzer to that revision

inventory.reason: The stored ASTM field is invalid under the accepted portable profile schema.
prerequisites: Correct or explicitly retire the invalid behavior
Do not enable any fallback or parallel classifier

rawIngress.migration: Bridge becomes the sole analyzer-facing runtime writer through normalized FHIR. Remove raw OpenELIS readers after traffic and rollback gates pass.

catalogCoverage.migration: Only one active candidate may be suggested, never silently selected. All other states remain visible and independently resolvable.

rollback.rule: Never reverse-transform target writes or enable dual write; restore the coordinated pre-cutover state or roll forward.
